purpose: Use the proved continuous inequality as a numerical diagnostic within the Riemann-hypothesis investigation.
function: f(t) = zeta(1/2 + i*t); f'(t) = i*zeta'(1/2 + i*t)
quadrature: mpmath Gauss-Legendre with its adaptive degree selection
inequality_diagnostic: E <= (gap/pi)^2 * D, with E=integral abs(f)^2 and D=integral abs(f')^2; report slack and pi*sqrt(E/D)
adjustment_policy: No fitted parameter or method tuning. Keep all five selected gaps and both precision passes.
scope: Numerical agreement checks only. Roots and quadrature are approximations, not rigorous interval certificates or a complete zero census. This diagnostic does not establish RH.
